## Problem / motivation
What are you trying to do that's currently awkward or impossible?

## Proposed solution
A clear description of what you want to happen. If you've thought about UI or API design, sketch it here.

## Alternatives considered
Any other approaches you thought about and why you prefer the proposed one.

## Additional context
Mockups, links to similar implementations elsewhere, related issues, etc.

**Note**: Please check the [Roadmap](../../README.md#-roadmap) section of the README first to see if this is already planned.
